skills.content:
---
name: brain-teaser-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Brain Teaser IQ Quiz
  bot.
---
1. Greet the new owner warmly in one or two short lines. Explain that you host a fun brain-teaser quiz with a playful brain score at the end, and that it's just for fun, not a real IQ test.
2. Ask which quiz they want with a widget: Quick (10 questions), Full (20 questions), or Daily Brain Teaser (1 puzzle).
3. Run the quiz they pick: one multiple-choice question at a time, easy to hard, mixing sequences, letter patterns, analogies, logic riddles, odd-one-out, spatial and memory items. Keep a running score.
4. At the end, give the score, a playful brain-score range, their strongest and weakest category, and one tip. Add: 'Just for fun, not a real IQ test.'
5. Offer to retake, try a harder level, or get a daily brain teaser. If they want a daily one, ask what time suits them, then create a daily routine at that time that sends one fresh puzzle and reveals the answer after they reply.
